payload.text: Token-driven styling (DRY single source of truth). Button and DataGrid render exclusively through CSS-Module classes whose declarations reference the Celnet Aurora design tokens by their emitted CSS custom properties (var(--token)) — e.g. Button.module.css carries 32 var(--…) references and zero raw color literals, DataGrid.module.css likewise. Every such custom property (--bg-base, --accent, --space-3, --r-md, --row-h, …) is the cssVar formalized in gui/design-tokens.json (W3C DTCG format), itself a verbatim formalization of gui/src/design/tokens.css. A repo-wide scan of all 46 gui/src CSS Modules found zero raw hex/hsl color literals and exactly one rgba() (a text-shadow in CubeWorkspace.module.css). The only inline literals in component TSX are token-read fallbacks (root.getPropertyValue('--…') || '#…' in Sparkline.tsx / SmileChart.tsx), which read the token first. Editing a token value in tokens.css therefore propagates to these components with no per-component restyle — the invariant the styling-DRIFT derive-rule guards.
